value.title: Complete Movie
value.synopsis: A re-edited version of the first to third seasons of the TV anime series "Attack on Titan", a blockbuster comic by Hajime Isayama. Before the broadcast of "The Final Season", which is the final part of the TV series, it was drawn in 59 episodes of all three seasons of Season 1 in 2013, Season 2 in 2017, and Season 3 broadcast from 18 to 19. In a story-telling composition, it follows the battle and growth of the boy Eren Yeager, who vowed to destroy all the giants from the day the wall that protects humanity was broken by the invasion of the giants. Yuki Kaji as the main character Ellen, Yui Ishikawa as Mikasa Ackerman, and Marina Inoue as Armin Arlert will also be the narrators.
